requirements: Users belong to tenants (memberships). A user may read a document of a tenant they belong to if the document's level is at most their clearance; tenant admins may read every document of their tenants. Members may create and update documents in their tenants within their clearance. Archived documents are hidden from everyone. Levels are 0..3. Admins must be members. A document never changes tenant. Additionally, owners can always read their own documents.
expected_properties: A user only sees, creates or updates documents of tenants they belong to.
Removing a membership never grants anyone access.
Levels stay in range; owners and admins stay members of their tenants.
Whatever a user writes, they can read back.
The application role has no privilege beyond select/insert/update on docs and reading memberships.
